tasks.title: Симулятор: планировщик oVirt
tasks.statement: Планировщик выбирает хост для запуска виртуальной машины в два шага: фильтры отбрасывают неподходящие хосты, веса ранжируют оставшиеся. В четырёх сценариях подберите политику кластера: включите нужные фильтры (память, сеть, антиаффинность) и расставьте веса (равномерная нагрузка, свободная память, упаковка). Машины запускаются по одной, каждая занимает место на выбранном хосте. Упражнение решено, когда цели всех сценариев выполнены. Модель упрощена: три веса — это упрощённые аналоги весовых модулей oVirt (равномерное число машин на хосте, свободная память, упаковка машин вместо энергосбережения по загрузке), а ранги записаны в зеркальной форме: лучший хост получает ранг 0, побеждает наименьшая сумма «коэффициент × ранг» (в самом oVirt лучший хост получает наибольший ранг и побеждает наибольшая сумма).
tasks.hint: Фильтры — жёсткие условия, веса — предпочтения. Без весов побеждает первый по имени хост. Равномерность и упаковка — противоположные веса, их не включают вместе. Нарушенное ограничение, которое политика не проверяла, считается ошибкой размещения.

scenarios.title: Even load
scenarios.goal: Start 6 VMs so that hosts differ by at most one VM
scenarios.hint: Without weights all hosts look the same and the first by name wins every time. Weights rank the hosts.

scenarios.title: Networks
scenarios.goal: Start 4 VMs on hosts that have their networks, with a spread of at most one VM
scenarios.hint: Not every host has every VLAN. A VM that lands on a host without its network starts with a dead NIC — the network filter prevents that.

scenarios.title: Anti-affinity
scenarios.goal: Start two database replicas on different hosts and two application VMs
scenarios.hint: The scheduler loves the emptiest host: without the affinity filter both replicas land there.

scenarios.title: Power saving
scenarios.goal: Start 5 VMs on at most two hosts so that every VM fits
scenarios.hint: Power saving is the opposite of an even load. But packing without the memory filter overfills the first host.

tasks.title: Доска: группы соответствия
tasks.statement: Вы расставляете машины по правилам соседства: держите реплики порознь, а части одного целого вместе. Пять сценариев: две реплики на одном хосте под жёсткой отрицательной группой; положительная группа, распавшаяся по трём хостам; три реплики на двух хостах, когда нужен третий хост; мягкая группа, которая никогда не меняет статус и лишь создаёт иллюзию защиты; две жёстких группы, противоречащие друг другу. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Жёсткая группа работает как фильтр: машина, которая её нарушает, не запустится. Мягкая группа — только вес, статуса она не меняет, и нарушение видно лишь в параметрах группы и машин. Машина стоит на одном хосте: чтобы переставить её, удалите связь с прежним хостом и создайте новую.

scenarios.title: Two replicas on one host
scenarios.story: db-1 and db-2 are replicas and must never share a host, yet one of them is Down although both hosts are Up and have plenty of memory.
scenarios.goal: All three VMs are running and the replicas are still in their group
scenarios.hint: Open the Down VM and read why it does not run: a hard group is a filter, not a wish. A VM sits on one host, so to move it delete its link to the host and link it to another one.

scenarios.title: A pod that fell apart
scenarios.story: app-1, cache-1 and log-1 are one unit and talk over the loopback of a single host. Two of them are Down on a healthy cluster.
scenarios.goal: The three VMs run together and all three hosts are Up
scenarios.hint: A positive hard group keeps its members on the host of the first member that is placed, and every other member elsewhere breaks it. Move the members that stand apart.

scenarios.title: Three replicas, two hosts
scenarios.story: The three etcd members must each live on a host of their own, but the cluster has only two hosts, so one member is always Down.
scenarios.goal: All three members run, each on its own host, and every host is Up
scenarios.hint: No move helps while there are fewer hosts than members. A new host must be a member of the cluster and have everything the other hosts have: the management network, the VM network and the storage domain.

scenarios.title: The rule that never fires
scenarios.story: The database replicas db-1 and db-2 are in an anti-affinity group, and the board is all green, yet both of them sit on host-1. The team was told the group guarantees they never share a host.
scenarios.goal: The db-spread group is enforced and everything is running with the replicas on different hosts
scenarios.hint: Open the group and read its parameters: a soft group is only a preference and never changes a status. Once it is hard, the VM that breaks it goes Down until it is moved.

scenarios.title: Together and apart
scenarios.story: app-1 and cache-1 are in two hard groups: near wants them on one host for latency, apart wants them on two hosts so that one host failure takes only one of them. cache-1 is Down, and moving it only swaps which group is broken.
scenarios.goal: Everything runs with app-1 and cache-1 on different hosts, the apart rule enforced and both groups still on the board
scenarios.hint: Two hard groups that contradict each other can never both hold. Decide which one is a requirement and which one is only a wish, and relax the wish.

tasks.title: Доска: память и ёмкость
tasks.statement: Вы считаете память так, как её считает планировщик: по обещанному, а не по занятому. Пять сценариев: хост, которому обещано больше памяти, чем у него есть, и все его машины Down; две HA-машины, которые при потере хоста делят остаток памяти; размещение новых машин там, где они помещаются; кластер, в котором память есть, но расставлена плохо; запас на потерю любого хоста (N+1). Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Сложите память машин, размещённых на хосте: если сумма больше памяти хоста, не работает ни одна из них, хотя сам хост остаётся Up. Перезапускаемые HA-машины занимают место одна за другой. Чтобы переставить машину, удалите связь с прежним хостом и создайте новую.

scenarios.title: Promised more than it has
scenarios.story: host-1 is Up and nothing is wrong with its networks or storage, but erp, crm and mail on it are all Down, while web-1 on host-2 runs.
scenarios.goal: All four VMs are running and both hosts are Up
scenarios.hint: Add up the memory of the VMs placed on host-1 and compare it with the memory of the host: the scheduler counts what is promised, so the VMs run only if the sum fits. Either the host gets more memory or some VMs go elsewhere.

scenarios.title: Two HA VMs, one survivor
scenarios.story: Both HA VMs run and host-1 has a fence agent, yet the portal cannot promise that they restart if host-1 is lost: host-2 is smaller and already runs batch.
scenarios.goal: If host-1 fails, both HA VMs restart on host-2, and everything keeps running and stays HA
scenarios.hint: Restarted VMs are placed one after the other, so each takes memory the next one needs. Count what is free on host-2 and make the two VMs fit together.

scenarios.title: Where does it fit
scenarios.story: report-1 and batch-1 were just created and have no host. The hosts are different: host-1 has 16 GB, host-2 has 32 GB and host-3 has 64 GB, and each already runs VMs.
scenarios.goal: All seven VMs are running, the new ones included, and every host is Up
scenarios.hint: Free memory of a host is its memory minus the memory of the VMs placed on it. A VM that does not fit does not just stay down: it makes every VM on that host Down.

scenarios.title: Room in the wrong place
scenarios.story: The cluster has memory to spare, but the VMs were placed badly: host-1 and host-2 are both promised more than they have, so six VMs are Down, while host-3 is almost empty.
scenarios.goal: All seven VMs are running and all three hosts are Up
scenarios.hint: Several VMs have to leave their hosts, so find the smallest set that brings each host under its memory. A VM sits on one host: delete the link to the old host, then link it to the new one.

scenarios.title: Survive the loss of any host
scenarios.story: db-1, db-2, web-1 and web-2 are HA, and a fence agent serves every host. cache-1 is critical too but is not HA, and the three hosts are full enough that nobody is sure what happens to a 16 GB VM when a host dies.
scenarios.goal: cache-1 is HA, and after the loss of any single host every HA VM restarts on the others
scenarios.hint: Make cache-1 HA first, then lose each host in your head: the VMs of the lost host must find room, one after the other, on the hosts that remain. Look for the host whose failure leaves no 16 GB gap.

tasks.title: Доска: обслуживание и эвакуация
tasks.statement: Вы готовите хосты к обслуживанию: чтобы перевести хост в maintenance, его машины должны переехать на другие хосты кластера. Пять сценариев: единственный хост кластера и запасной хост в чужом кластере; хост в обслуживании, на котором осталась машина; эвакуация, которую блокирует отсутствующая на целевом хосте сеть; эвакуация, которую блокирует память целевого хоста; кластер из трёх хостов, где обновление идёт по одному. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Машина переезжает в пределах своего кластера на хост в состоянии Up, где есть её сети и хватает памяти. Хост в обслуживании не принимает машины и сам не должен держать их. Проверяйте каждый хост по очереди, а не только тот, который собираетесь обслуживать.

scenarios.title: A spare host in the wrong cluster
scenarios.story: Billing-1 runs on host-1, the only host of cluster-a. Host-2 is Up and idle, but it sits in cluster-b, and the patch window for host-1 is tonight.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and billing-1 has another Up host in its own cluster to move to
scenarios.hint: A VM never leaves its cluster, so a host in another cluster is no help. A host belongs to one cluster, and a host that joins a cluster needs the networks and storage of that cluster.

scenarios.title: Maintenance with a VM left behind
scenarios.story: Host-2 was switched to maintenance for a memory upgrade, but db-1 is still placed on it. The portal shows db-1 as down and the environment is not healthy.
scenarios.goal: Host-2 stays in maintenance and all three VMs run on other hosts
scenarios.hint: A host in maintenance runs nothing, and switching the flag does not move the VMs by itself on this board. Place the VM on another host of the cluster.

scenarios.title: Green board, blocked evacuation
scenarios.story: Both hosts are Up and both VMs run, yet neither host can be put into maintenance: the portal says there is nowhere to move the VMs. Web-1 uses front-net and db-1 uses db-net, and each of those networks is optional.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and each host can be evacuated to the other one
scenarios.hint: A VM moves only to a host that has the network of its NIC, and an optional network may be missing without any warning. Check which hosts have which network.

scenarios.title: Room on the target host
scenarios.story: Host-1 runs analytics-1 and web-1, host-2 runs web-2. Everything is Up, but host-1 cannot be put into maintenance: host-2 is an old machine with 16 GB.
scenarios.goal: Everything works, every host can be evacuated and the VMs keep their size
scenarios.hint: A VM moves to a host only if the memory of all VMs already there plus its own fits into the memory of that host. A host that is exactly full is still fine.

scenarios.title: Patching one host at a time
scenarios.story: The cluster is patched host by host. Host-2 is finished and empty, but nobody took it out of maintenance, so now host-1 and host-3 have nowhere to go.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and every host that runs VMs can be evacuated
scenarios.hint: A host in maintenance is not a target for evacuation. Finish the previous step before you start the next one.
